lead: COP31 collapses in Antalya · Russia strikes Kyiv region again · Anthropic IPO slides 9%

cards.head: COP31 collapses after 44 hours of overtime
cards.body: Nearly 200 countries failed to adopt the Antalya Pact; the EU and others rejected a text that softened language on fossil fuels.

cards.head: Russian drone hits apartment block in Kyiv region
cards.body: At least 14 people are missing after a night strike; rescue work continued into the morning under cold rain.

cards.head: Indonesia factory fire search resumes
cards.body: Police removed 24 body bags from the burned shell as families waited for news of the missing.

cards.head: Anthropic falls 9% after record IPO
cards.body: The listing failed to calm investor fears about AI spending; chip stocks followed the slide.

cards.head: South Korea's education minister quits
cards.body: The minister resigned over a cheating scandal that has spread from exam halls to university admissions.

cards.head: Russia tows cargo ship hit by drones
cards.body: Finland's coast guard says a rescue vessel began towing the damaged ship in the Baltic on Sunday.

cards.head: Three Russian missiles crossed into Poland
cards.body: Prosecutors confirmed the Friday incursion; Nato members are reviewing the response.

cards.head: Ebola response disrupted by fighting
cards.body: WHO chief Tedros called for peace in eastern DR Congo as aid convoys stalled.

cards.head: US probes alleged Nvidia chip diversion
cards.body: The Director of National Intelligence called the firm a perpetual target for smugglers.

cards.head: US consumers hold up into the holidays
cards.body: Retail data suggests spending has stayed resilient despite price pressures.

cards.head: Manila: 'big trade deal' still under negotiation
cards.body: The palace pushed back on claims that terms with Washington were already agreed.

cards.head: Assange appears for ADF leaker
cards.body: The WikiLeaks founder made a rare public appearance at a court hearing in Australia.

briefs: Three Russian missiles crossed into Poland on Friday, prosecutors say, as Nato reviews the incident.
WHO chief Tedros pleads for peace as fighting disrupts the Ebola response in eastern DR Congo.
Washington is investigating an alleged scheme to divert Nvidia's high-end chips, the DNI says.
Julian Assange makes a rare public appearance in support of the ADF leaker.
US consumers are still spending into the holidays despite inflation, retailers report.
Manila says a 'big trade deal' with Washington is still under negotiation.
Analysts ask whether climate diplomacy can build on the collapse of COP31.
Rescue teams in Kyiv region work through a second night of drone alerts.
Chipmakers extend losses as AI spending doubts spread through the sector.
Indonesia's police face questions over safety inspections at the factory.
Seoul's exam scandal widens to private tutoring firms.
Baltic states press for a joint response to drone incursions.
COP31's failure leaves the 1.5C stocktake without a formal decision.
Kyiv's air defences report another long night of drone launches.
Anthropic's bankers defend the listing price after the first-day slide.
Baltic insurers raise premiums for cargo routed past Russian ports.
Indonesia's labour ministry orders inspections at similar plants.
Seoul announces a review of private exam academies.
